docs.title: Contact

docs.text: Hi, I'm Bhanumati Seervi Senior Robotics Software Engineer | Robotics • Real-Time Systems • Motion Control • Computer Vision I'm a Senior Robotics Software Engineer with ~5 years of experience across surgical robotics, collaborative robots, teleoperation, and autonomous mobile robots . My work focuses on developing reliable robotics software involving C++, Python, ROS/ROS2, real-time systems, robot control, kinematics, computer vision, and EtherCAT-based communication . I hold an M.Tech. in Advanced Manufacturing & Design from IIT Jodhpur , with a strong foundation in robotics, control systems, kinematics, dynamics, and mechatronics. Gurugram, India | July 2025 – Present Working on software for surgical robotic systems. Integrated a voice control module with a real-time system for hands-free control of an endoscopic manipulator. Developed a computer vision pipeline using a stereo RGB camera and NVIDIA Jetson Orin AGX for real-time object detection and tracking. Worked on perception capabilities for improved intraoperative awareness. Mechatronics Engineer — SS Innovations International Inc. Gurugram, India | November 2022 – July 2025 Characterised and compensated actuator friction in harmonic gear drives. Automated the friction calibration and compensation pipeline for repeatable joint performance. Designed and implemented gravity compensation for a 7-DoF surgical manipulator . Built a complete Actin-based simulation of the surgical robotic system to accelerate control-system development and testing. Senior Research Fellow — Robotics Lab, IIT Jodhpur December 2021 – July 2022 Teleoperation & Haptics | TIH for Cobotics, IIT Delhi funded project Contributed to a telepresence and teleaction system for robot-assisted dentistry . Integrated a UR5 manipulator and Phantom Touch haptic device using ROS. Implemented Jacobian-based end-effector control and trajectory tracking. Developed force-feedback and workspace-confinement mechanisms for safe teleoperation. Project Assistant — Autonomous Helicopter Lab, IIT Jodhpur September 2022 – December 2022 Rotorcraft Dynamics | Prof. C. Venkatesan Performed dynamic load analysis of an oscillating rotor under different RPM and oscillation-frequency conditions. Designed and assembled an adjustable experimental test rig. Integrated a 6-DoF load cell, servo actuator, optical encoder, and Arduino Mega . Projects Multi-Robot Collaborative Control & Teleoperation May 2021 – July 2022 Developed collaborative behaviours for a swarm of four TurtleBot3 robots controlled through a single 3-axis joystick. Implemented: Aggregation Dispersion Homing Go-to-goal Obstacle avoidance Technology: ROS TurtleBot3 Vicon Motion Capture P3DX Differential Drive Robot March 2021 – April 2022 Developed an autonomous navigation stack for a P3DX differential-drive robot. docs.text: My Projects Multi-robot Collaborative Control and Tele-operation May 2022 – Jul 2022 | Details | Code Program a swarm of four Turtlebots for collaborative behavior such as aggregation, dispersion, homing, go to goal, and obstacle avoidance. Input from a single operator using a joystick. TurtleBot3, Vicon motion capture system for odometry, 3-axis joystick, ROS. Telepresence and Teleaction in Robot Assisted Dentistry Dec 2021 – Jul 2022 | Details | Link Interface the UR5 manipulator and Phantom Touch haptic devices with ROS (Robot Operating System). Position control and trajectory tracking of the end-effector using Jacobian-based control. Developed a program to control the motion of the robotic manipulator using a 6-DoF haptic device. Workspace confinement and force feedback on the haptic device. Estimation of time delay between the input position given by the haptic device and the output end-effector position. P3DX Differential Drive Robot Mar 2022 – Apr 2022 | Details | Link Implemented go-to-goal using PID control with obstacle avoidance using the Artificial Potential Field method. Implemented geometric path-tracking algorithms such as Pure Pursuit and Stanley controller. Waypoint navigation. P3DX, Vicon motion capture system for odometry, ROS. Dynamic Load Analysis of an Oscillating Rotor Sep 2021 – Dec 2021 | Details | Link Designed an adjustable test rig and mounted it with a 6-DoF load cell, servo actuator, and optical encoder interface using Arduino Mega. Load measurements were performed at various rotor RPMs and oscillation frequencies. Forces were also observed along the direction in which the component of rotor thrust was zero.
